subscriptionCosts.intro: A subscription is not free: its fee is spread over the work it can do between limit resets. Resets make this uncertain, so each estimate is a range. Budgets count subscription use at this estimate; the daily paid AI allowance does not.
subscriptionCosts.costRange: About {$point} per million tokens (likely between {$low} and {$high})
subscriptionCosts.costCeiling: About {$point} per million tokens at most
subscriptionCosts.basis: Based on {$days} days of use. Limits were reached in {$limited} of {$active} {$hours}-hour windows.
subscriptionCosts.basisCeiling: Its limits were not reached in {$days} days of use, so this is the most it costs; the real figure is probably lower.
subscriptionCosts.feeMissing: Record the plan's payment to estimate its cost.
subscriptionCosts.noUsage: No use recorded in the last 30 days, so there is nothing to divide the fee by yet.
subscriptionCosts.currencyUnsupported: The fee is in {$currency}; only USD fees are estimated so far.
